publications.title: When Intelligence Fails Successfully
publications.subtitle: What OpenAI’s Navier–Stokes breakthrough teaches us about human agency and the rise of General Intelligence
publications.summary: Frontier AI can expand intellectual capability while weakening the shared conditions that regenerate useful intelligence. This paper proposes Blackout and Whiteout as possible failure boundaries and provenance, reciprocity, triage and forking as responses.

publications.title: The Common Relationship Hypothesis
publications.subtitle: A Provenance Note on Three Observational Domains and the Search for a Shared Invariant
publications.summary: A bounded question asking whether galactic dynamics, cosmological redshift and the cosmic microwave background could reflect a shared, presently undefined relational structure. The note records nonclaims and conditions under which the hypothesis fails.
